_ghi_chu: Mo hinh nhan dang ngon ngu FireRedLID (PyTorch, can torch) cho che do dich (chep_loi_goc.py --lid), chep nguyen ban tu HuggingFace len GitHub Release rieng (workflow lid-models.yml dang, dung chung tools/publish_asr_models.sh). scripts/lay_asr.py lid tai tu release truoc, HuggingFace o dung revision duoi la du phong; ca hai deu kiem sha256. model.pth.tar lon hon 2 GiB nen chia parts (split -b 1500M -d -a 2), lay_asr.py ghep lai roi kiem sha256 file day du. Ma suy luan o scripts/vendor/fireredlid (chep nguyen ban tu FireRedTeam/FireRedASR2S, commit ghi trong vendor/fireredlid/NGUON.md). Doi revision: dat release_tag moi, cap nhat revision, size, sha256 tung file theo API HuggingFace, chay thu dau cuoi. Khong xoa hay tao lai release da dang.
release_title: Mo hinh nhan dang ngon ngu FireRedLID (lid-firered-1bb4d28)
release_notes:
Mo hinh nhan dang ngon ngu FireRedLID cho che do dich cua skill video-studio (chep_loi_goc.py --lid), chep nguyen ban (khong sua) tu HuggingFace de tai nhanh va khong phu thuoc huggingface.co.

- FireRedTeam/FireRedLID @ 1bb4d285c8456429385d9c0810300df4297bc11b (Apache-2.0)

Ten file: ban (lid) va ten file goc, noi bang "--". model.pth.tar lon hon 2 GiB (gioi han moi file cua release) nen chia thanh .part00, .part01, .part02; scripts/lay_asr.py ghep lai va kiem sha256 file day du. Ma kiem tra trong SHA256SUMS, khop video-studio/assets/lid-models.json.
Giay phep: LICENSE-firered.txt (FireRedASR2S, Apache-2.0). Thong tin goc: README-FireRedLID.md (the mo hinh nguyen ban).
Khong xoa hay tao lai release nay: scripts/lay_asr.py tro thang vao ten tag.
